content:
Let \(D\) be the originally planned duration. Equate planned and actual total work:
\[
4D = 3(D+3)+2
\]
\[
4D = 3D+11
\]
\[
D=11
\]
So each of the other three worked \(11+3=14\) days, while Xiao Li worked \(2\) days.

The difference in work is:
\[
14-2=12 \text{ days}
\]
This difference corresponds to 2700 yuan, so one day’s pay is:
\[
2700 \div 12 = 225
\]
Xiao Li worked 2 days:
\[
2 \times 225 = 450
\]

\[
\boxed{450}
\]
